title_guess: Skewflation: when a few items in the price basket rise much faster

segments.teaches: the general price level of an economy can fall (deflation) or rise (inflation)

elements.what: economy -> general price level -> decrease / increase -> deflation / inflation
cream chips for deflation and inflation leaves

segments.notes: plain thin-text tree on white; node text fades from grey to black as it is spoken

segments.teaches: the general price level is measured with a basket of sample commodities from all strata

elements.what: lavender box behind the general price level node
shopping basket labelled BASKET joined to the node
short basket definition above the icon

segments.notes: side attachment: a concept node gets a concrete icon and a definition

segments.teaches: the basket holds many commodities whose prices rise by different amounts; their average is the overall price

elements.what: basket now at the centre with 'overall price' chip
overall price -> decrease / increase -> deflation / inflation below the basket
yellow panel with a row of coloured blocks standing for many commodities
black up arrows of different heights above each block
blue underline bars appear under overall price, deflation and inflation

segments.notes: arrow height = size of price rise per item, a light visual metaphor for a weighted average

segments.teaches: skewflation: a few goods rise much faster than overall inflation

elements.what: magenta box around two commodity blocks whose arrows grow very tall
curved arrow from the SKEWFLATION label to the boxed blocks
channel app phone mock-up slides up over the bottom-left in the last 15 s

segments.notes: the concept is shown by exaggerating 2 arrows inside the existing composition, no new canvas; very short video, only one idea

elements.what: next video / playlist panels with app phone mock-up and store badges
